claims.text: Most reviewers describe the hair as soft and praise its quality, often saying they would buy it again.
Many reviewers report little to no shedding and no tangling with proper care.
Several reviewers note the bundles are thick and full, though a few mention the hair or ends get thinner.
A minority of negative reviewers complain about excessive shedding, tangling, and fillers, with one doubting the authenticity of positive reviews.
Some reviewers mention a slight smell out of the package that washes out, while others report no odor at all.
